decisions.decision: Dockerfile uses uv + deps-first layering + BuildKit cache mounts + uv sync --frozen
decisions.rationale: code edits no longer bust dep cache; --frozen pulls from files.pythonhosted.org CDN by pinned URL/hash, bypasses pypi.org index (resilient to index outages, byte-reproducible)
codeql.yml already declares correct permissions: security-events: write; failure is a GitHub platform outage, not config

decisions.decision: MCP design: start with param enums + verifying gateway forwarding before building resources
decisions.rationale: thin param docs / non-enum types are the biggest correctness lever; resources/prompts value depends on whether the gateway forwards them

context_notes: Milestone v1.1 is 100% complete (15/15 phases) but unarchived — owner not closing it; optional /gsd-complete-milestone available. This session was post-milestone maintenance + an MCP design DISCUSSION (not implementation). The MCP surface: 6 tools, 3 prompts (daily brief / weekly digest / shoe watchdog, en+ru), 0 resources. Tool annotations are correct and uniform (readOnly/idempotent/non-destructive/closed-world). Real weakness: tool params lack descriptions and enums are plain str not Literal, so the calling agent guesses date formats and valid values for bucket/scope/scenarios/sport/metric_bundle. Also -> dict[str, Any] makes structured_output schema opaque. No background processes running.
